g2-implement.title: G2 models + LOSO CV + bootstrap CIs + measurement
g2-implement.imperative: Extend metalearner.py: Model1 (logistic over the 4 Delta-pi, scipy.optimize, no bias on symmetric ordering) = best linear pool; Model2a (degree-2 product terms of the 4 Delta-pi, same logistic objective) and Model2b (small torch MLP on the 4 Delta-pi). LOSO CV over seasons; pooled held-out pairwise log-loss per task; bootstrap CI over EVENTS for Delta_gap = Model1_loss - Model2_loss. #140 deviation probe: nested gain from adding per-scope deviation terms to Model1. Emit a JSON results artifact per task with point estimates + CIs + secondary rank_mae/spearman. Add a runner CLI (py -m scripts.fusion_replay.metalearner). Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent. Commander then RUNS the measurement in foreground and captures the JSON.

g2-integrate.result: Gate decided. Per-task: quali DEFER, race_start GREENLIGHT, race GREENLIGHT. #140 deviation ABSENT all tasks. Overall: GREENLIGHT #375 scoped to downstream tasks {race_start, race}; DEFER for quali. Conservative lower-bound caveat applies (meta-learner sees only module outputs; #414 proved feature-level info the head distills badly, which this under-counts).
g2-integrate.finding: Interaction headroom over module outputs EXISTS and is material for the two downstream tasks (race_start +1.23pp, race +0.62pp pairwise-LL, both significant) but NOT for quali (+0.05pp, not significant). Signal is carried only by the antisymmetric MLP (Model2b); explicit degree-2 cross-products (Model2a) add nothing, so the structure is non-multiplicative / higher-order. #140 weekend-vs-recent deviation adds no ordering power beyond main effects in any task.
